admin_sync_price.description: Mode C only: admin-pushed mid (demo fallback).

mint.description: Mint next token to sender if whitelist + price checks pass.

set_price_policy.description: Admin: update price policy (bps, staleness, fallback, filters).

withdraw.description: Owner: withdraw native proceeds to `proceeds` (or specified recipient).

definitions.name: hm_loyalty_whitelist_LoyaltyProof
definitions.description: On-chain / client proof payload (hex-encoded siblings + root).

address.description: Bech32 (or chain) address that was hashed into the leaf.

leaf.description: Optional precomputed leaf hex; recomputed from address if omitted.

root.description: Expected root hex (optional cross-check against stored root).

algo.description: Optional filter: only accept sudo for this algo.

asset_id.description: Optional asset filter when decoding JSON price payloads (`asset` field).

bps_band.description:
Half-width band in basis points around mid. 0 = exact mid only.
Payment must satisfy mid * (1 - bps/10000) ..= mid * (1 + bps/10000).

chain_uid.description: Optional filter: only accept sudo for this chain_uid.

fallback_unit_price.description: When oracle disabled or mid absent: fixed unit price in `denom` microunits.

max_staleness_seconds.description: Fail closed when mid is older than this many seconds (vs `env.block.time`).

usd_to_unit_scale.description:
If attestation has `price_usd` (decimal string) and no direct mid,
mid = round(price_usd * usd_to_unit_scale). Demo FX only.

admin_sync.description: Mode C: admin ExecuteMsg sync (demo fallback only).

query.description: Mode B: pull/query another store (stub for frameworks; not required in v0 minter).

sudo.description: Mode A: x/hashmerchant sudo push (preferred long-term).

cw_ownable_Action
definitions.description: Actions that can be taken to alter the contract's ownership

accept_ownership.description:
Accept the pending ownership transfer.

Can only be called by the pending owner.

renounce_ownership.description:
Give up the contract's ownership and the possibility of appointing
a new owner.

Can only be invoked by the contract's current owner.

Any existing pending ownership transfer is canceled.

transfer_ownership.description:
Propose to transfer the contract's ownership to another account,
optionally with an expiry time.

Can only be called by the contract's current owner.

Any existing pending ownership transfer is overwritten.

definitions.name: cw_utils_expiration_Expiration
definitions.description:
Expiration represents a point in time when some event happens.
It can compare with a BlockInfo and will return is_expired() == true
once the condition is hit (and for every block in the future)

never.description: Never will never expire. Used to express the empty variant
